title: AlertResource
description: A monitor alert representing a detected condition.

start.description: When the alert condition first occurred

end.description: When the alert condition ended. Null for active alerts.

detectedStart.description: When the alert start was detected by the monitoring system. Null when not yet detected.

detectedEnd.description: When the alert end was detected by the monitoring system. Null for active alerts.

groupingHash.description: Hash of the grouping values for this alert

monitorVersion.description: Version of the monitor when this alert was created

monitor.description:
Reference to the monitor that generated this alert. Always carries
the id; the `record` field is populated only when expand=true.

muted.description: Whether the alert is currently muted by active mute rules.

aiChats.description:
Optional field tied to a feature under development. Where that
feature is not enabled the key is omitted from the response
entirely, rather than returned as an empty array; it becomes
required once the feature is generally available.

AI investigations for this alert, newest first; empty when it has
never been investigated. An investigation is started either
automatically, when the alert's monitor has AI triaging enabled, or
by a user from the alert.

automaticInvestigation.description:
The current state or terminal result of the automatic AI
investigation attempt for this alert. Null when automatic
investigation was not enabled or no attempt was made.

Optional field tied to a feature under development. Where that
feature is not enabled the key is omitted from the response,
matching `aiChats`.

resolvedServiceBinding.description:
Resolved (service.name, deployment.environment.name,
service.namespace) triplet this alert is attributed to.
Omitted only when the alert's monitor has no service binding
declared. When a binding wildcard does not resolve to a value
for this alert, that dimension is an empty string.

stats.description: Action statistics for this alert. Only included when expand=true.

Alert-ActionStats.title: AlertActionStats
Alert-ActionStats.description: Statistics about notification actions taken for this alert

lastMutedAt.description: When the alert was last muted. Null if never muted.

lastSentAt.description: When a notification was last sent. Null if never sent.

lastErroredAt.description: When the last notification error occurred. Null if no errors.

chat.description:
The automatically created investigation chat. Non-null when
outcome is `Started` or `Completed`.

Alert-AutomaticInvestigationOutcome.title: AlertAutomaticInvestigationOutcome
Alert-AutomaticInvestigationOutcome.description: Current state or terminal result of an automatic AI investigation attempt.

Alert-CapturedValue.title: AlertCapturedValue
Alert-CapturedValue.description: A value captured at the time the alert was triggered

value.description: The captured cell value. Null when the cell had no value.

Alert-Column.title: AlertColumn
Alert-Column.description:
A column reference, either a direct column path, a link column, or a
correlation tag. Exactly one of `linkColumn`, `columnPath`, or
`correlationTag` is non-null.

name.description:
The column's identifier within its dataset. This is the programmatic
name used to look up the column, not a display label.

path.description: Optional dotted path into a nested column. Null when absent.

Alert-ContextEntry.title: AlertContextEntry
Alert-ContextEntry.description: A context entry representing a grouping value for which the alert triggered

Alert-CorrelationTag.title: AlertCorrelationTag
Alert-CorrelationTag.description:
A correlation tag reference. The tag identifier is the canonical
name; the resolved backing column(s) are server-side details and
not part of the wire shape.

name.description:
The link column's identifier. This is the programmatic name used to
look up the column, not a display label.

Alert-ResolvedServiceBinding.title: AlertResolvedServiceBinding
Alert-ResolvedServiceBinding.description:
Service-binding triplet for an alert. Present whenever the alert's
monitor has a service binding declared; a dimension that does not
resolve to a value is an empty string. Omitted only when the
monitor has no service binding declared.

Chat-Alert.title: ChatAlert
Chat-Alert.description: Reference to the alert that triggered this chat.

Chat-Brief.title: ChatBrief
Chat-Brief.description: Brief chat metadata included when a reference is expanded.

label.description: Human-visible title. Null when the chat has no title.

Chat-FullMessage.title: ChatFullMessage
Chat-FullMessage.description:
A message within a chat including the actual message "parts".
Message parts may e.g. contain image data and be quite big, but
often also just contain a text snippet.

Chat-FullMessage-CreateRequest.title: ChatFullMessageCreateRequest
Chat-FullMessage-CreateRequest.description:
A message within a chat including message parts.
Message parts may e.g. contain image data and be quite big.

id.description: Client-generated message id scoped to the chat.

indexedText.description:
The full text contained in `parts` for full text indexing.

Since the schema of the message parts is not fully known to
the API server, the client needs to fill this field with the logically
contained text.

The contents of this field are not shown to the user --
the UI uses the more structured information in the `parts` field for
that.

parts.description: The message parts as defined by the AI SDK. Potentially large.

Chat-Message-ReadOnly.title: ChatMessageReadOnly
Chat-Message-ReadOnly.description: The readonly server fields of a message within a chat.

id.description: Client-generated message id scoped to the chat.

index.description: Zero-based index of the message within the chat. Output only.

chatRevision.description: The chat revision that includes the last update of this message. Output only.

Chat-MessageMetadata.title: ChatMessageMetadata
Chat-MessageMetadata.description: Free-form metadata associated with the message (timings, etc.).

Chat-Ref.title: ChatRef
Chat-Ref.description:
Reference to a chat. Always carries the `id`. The `record` field is
populated with brief metadata only when `expand=true`.

Chat-Resource.title: ChatResource
Chat-Resource.description:
A chat resource - a conversation with the LLM agent.

The content of the conversation is in separate messages which
can be inlined into the resource for some operations with `?expand=true`.

id.description: Uniquely identifies a chat. Output only.

revision.description: Monotonically increasing with every update to the chat or its messages. Output only.

activeStreamId.description:
ID of the currently active stream, or null when no stream is active.
Used to determine whether the chat is in-progress (streaming) or idle/completed.

alert.description: The alert that triggered this chat, or null if not alert-triggered.

Chat-UIMessagePart.title: ChatUIMessagePart
Chat-UIMessagePart.description:
A message part. The schema is provided by the AI SDK, see
https://ai-sdk.dev/docs/reference/ai-sdk-core/ui-message#uimessagepart-types

This commonly embeds image data, so it can be quite big, but
often also just contains a snippet of text.

The backend itself does NOT validate the contents of any part
except requiring a string type field.

This field is not part of the explicit schema since not all code
generators support a required type field and capturing additional
properties in a catch-all field.

The client must validate this field for validity before use.

Monitor-Brief.title: MonitorBrief
Monitor-Brief.description: Brief monitor metadata included when a reference is expanded.

name.description: Name of the monitor, unique within its workspace.

description.description: The monitor's description. Null when no description is configured.

Monitor-Ref.title: MonitorRef
Monitor-Ref.description:
Reference to a monitor. Always carries the `id`. The `record` field is
populated with brief metadata only when `expand=true`.

ObjectBrief.title: ObjectBrief
ObjectBrief.description: Brief record fields for an ObjectRef. This type is polymorphic: additional fields pointing to specific object types (e.g. dataset, dashboard, monitor) may be added in the future as needed.

managedBy.description: Owner/manager of this object. Always returned as an id-only ObjectRef even when the parent was requested with expand=true: `expand` populates a single layer of brief data, so `record.managedBy` on a brief is itself never expanded. Pass the inner id back through a separate request (or filter via CEL, which lazily resolves) to access the manager's brief.

ObjectRef.title: ObjectRef
ObjectRef.description: A reference to another resource. Always carries the id; the optional `record` field carries the brief metadata, populated when expand=true. Brief expansion applies to one layer only — fields inside `record` that are themselves ObjectRefs (e.g. `record.managedBy`) are returned id-only, never with their own `record` populated. CEL filter expressions can deeper-resolve via lazy wrapper resolution if needed.
